text: Great!. We love this coat rack! We are using it in our bathroom behind the door so the folding hooks are very convenient. Only thing was when we went to install the grommet went right through the wall so I had to use other ones I had at the house.

product_metadata.title: JSVER Coat Rack Wall Mount Wooden Coat Hooks, Coat Hooks Wall Mounted with 3 Standard Retractable Hooks, Space-Saving Coat Rack for Entryway, Hallway, Bathroom, Living Room, Bedroom
features: Simple but Functional- This rack is a perfect storage option for your hallway, entryway, bedroom and more, providing a convenient hanging space for your coats, towels, umbrellas, wallets, scarves, hats and more.

Premium Materials- Made of natural bamboo and aluminum alloy, the hooks are lightweight, durable, rustproof, and perfect for your decor. Each hook stands weight up to 8lbs/3.6kg; Maximum weight supported: 24lbs/11kg
Hide-away Hooks- The hooks can stay tucked away and hidden when not in use, keeping us from bumping it and getting hurt, and saving space in a cramped room.

2 Methods to Install- The hooks can be securely mounted on a wall with screws, while 3M adhesive tapes offer an alternative to drilling. Easy to install, no tools required, and removes cleanly and damage-free.
Neat & Sleek- The smooth surface and hooks allow you to keep a variety of essentials and accessories organized without damaging them.
description: A nice simple design to hold your stuff from a collapsible fixture and help you keep everything separated and organized
Perfect for hanging a variety of items such astowels, hats, handbags, clothes, wallets, keys, umbrellas, backpacks and more.
If the hooks are not in use, you can retract them so the hooks get out of the way and the whole unit would look like a cool decoration.
The finish of the wood is excellent and the hooks are smooth with no sharp edges.
Good combination of natural wood plate and metal hooks for a modern and functional piece.
The mounting hardware is included, making installation a breeze.
